notes: Modified cash basis school district; no business-type funds (School Nutrition is in the governmental funds statement), so business_type is null. Basic statement lines come from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (pages 9, 11, 13; trimmed pp 8-15). The statement's 'Local Receipts' (3,218,027.13) is split into per-line items using the fund schedules (General Sched A p17, Special Building p26, Activities p23, School Nutrition p25); splits add to the printed line (2,926,310.94 + 135,503.44 + 156,043.56 + 169.19). 'Non-Revenue Receipts' 308,613.07 is split into General fund 42.00 + 2,298.77 and Depreciation Fund 300,000.00 + 6,272.30; the 300,000 'Allocation from General Fund' is counted by the report as a receipt (not a transfer) so it stays in receipts. Transfers 265,054.09 = General 265,000 + Student Fee 54.09 (transfers in = Activities 115,000 + Nutrition 150,000 + General 54.09). Roll-forward: 4,682,144.96 + 6,725,419.38 - 6,495,626.91 + 265,054.09 - 265,054.09 = 4,911,937.43. Detail: General Fund recorded from Schedule A (receipts) and Schedule B (disbursements by program, not itemized); Schedule M (operational expenses by object, unaudited) is truncated in the trimmed PDF (pages 28-30 only reach program 2171) and duplicates Schedule B, so it was not recorded. Schedule A-1 (p16) is a summary and was not recorded. Lines with blank actuals (e.g. 1925, 3551 receipts, 2153, 2163, 2210, 2224, 2640, 2712, 3400, 6412, 6969, 6990 disbursements, Special Building 5301) were skipped. Employee Benefit and Student Fee schedules print no total receipts/disbursements so no detail_totals for them. Statement of Net Position (Exhibit I) liabilities are 0.00. Read pages 1-30 of 30.
